book.name: Luka
book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Luka

content: Ulenganesu waka mbomba joaweliwi na ndomi na mtemula
Bhela Yesu akabhalandi bhabhulwa bhaki ulenganesu ghongo kwa kubhabhola kubha bhapalika kundobha Chapanga kila lichobha panga na kutonda.
Akapwaghike, “Ku muchi ghumu kukabhi na mtemula jumu jwangakunjoghopa Chapanga wala ngacheapalika bhandu.
Pa muchi ghonighola, kukabhi na mbomba jumu joaweliwi na ndomi joakabhi anjende mtemula jola panga kutonda na kumpwaghila, ‘Chondi, unyemalya mbata chechibhi changu kuhuma kwaka adui wangu!’
Kwa chikahi chilachu mtemula jola akakaniki kunjangatila mbomba joaweliwi na ndomi jola. Nambu palongi akalilaluki mweni, ‘Hata ngati nepani ngachenunjoghopa Chapanga wala ngachenabhapala bhandu,
nambu maghambu mbomba ajoju joaweliwi na ndomi apetali kung'aha ananunjangatya apata chekibhi chaki, nanga bhela anaajendalya kunhikila na kundenda ndondaje!’ ”
Bhela Bambo akabhapwaghile, “Njowanya ntundu mtemula muhakau ajo moapwaghile.
Bho, Chapanga le ngaabhakengaleli bhahaghulika bhaki, bhabhundelela ikilu na muhi? Bho, anaakabhakya le kwajangatila?
Numpwaghi mabhanganya, anabhajangatya manyata. Nambu Mwana waka Mundu paanahikaje, bho, anakubya le na uhobhalelu pani pundema?”
Ulengenesu waka Mfalisayo na njopa kode
Yesu akalongi kabheti ulenganesu aghoghu kwa ndandi ja bhandu bhala bhabhabhi na makoma na kubhalongale mahakau bhajabhu.
“Lichobha limu bhandu bhabheli bhakapiti kulobha mu Nyumba jaka Chapanga. Jumu akabhi Mfalisayo na jongi akabhi njopa kode.

“Mufalisayo jola akajemiki, koni akalobha mumtima waki ana, ‘Nukuchengu wa Chapanga, maghambu nepani ngachemi ngati bhandu bhangi bhokapi bhabhabhi bhanyaghula, bhabhatenda mahakau, na bhabhatenda ugone. Nukuchengu bhelabhela maghambu nepani ngachemi ngati njopa kode ajoju.
Nepani ngonga kula chilebhe machobha ghabheli kwa juma, na moha pandu pa komi pa hindu yangu yokapi yembata.’

“Nambu njopa kode jola akajemiki cha kutali, najombi ngachealengiki hata kulingali kunani kumahunde, nambu akalilapwilapwi pachihimba kwa kumbina mtima na kupwagha, ‘Wenga wa Chapanga, umonila chiha nepani mwana mahoku!’ ”

Yesu akajendali kupwagha, “Numpwaghila, mundu ajoju njopa kode akabhujiki kunyumba jaki koni akabya ajetakaliwi palongi jaka Chapanga, nambu nga Mfalisayo jola. Maghambu kila mundu joalikweha, anahelalikaje, nambu kila mundu joaliheleha, anakwehakikaje.”
Yesu abhapengale bhana bhachoku
Bhandu bhakundeti Yesu bhana bhachoku nahuli abhabhekila mabhoku na kubhapengalela. Bhabhulwa pabhaweni bhenibhela, bhakabhalakali bhandu bhanibhala.
Nambu Yesu akabhakemiki bhana bhahikaje na kupwagha, “Mwaleka bhana bhachoku bhahika kwangu, wala ngamwahibhalila, maghambu Ukolongwa waka Chapanga nde wa bhandu bhabhalengana na bhana.
Chakaka numpwaghila, mundu jokapi jwangakujopalela Ukolongwa waka Chapanga ngati mwana nchoku, ngawezi kujingila mu Ukolongwa hoghu ng'o.”
Nkombu mwanahindu yamaheli
Chiongozi jumu wa Bhayahude akundaluki Yesu, “Mbola Wambone, bho, ndenda bhole nahuli mbata womi wa mileli?”
Yesu akandalukile, “Bho maghambu ki unoha nepani wambone? Nga mundu joabhi wambone nambu Chapanga kanjika jaki.
Wimanyi amule: ‘Ngawitenda ugone, ngawikoma, ngawijibha, ngawilonge ichole, wajinika atati waku na mabhu waku.’ ”
Jombi akamuyangiki, “Amuli yokapi ayeyi nikamwi kutumbu uchoku wangu.”

Yesu paakajowini ghanihagha, akampwaghile, “Ukepakiwi na chindu chimo. Ujenda ukalombisa hindu yokapi yeubhi nayo, na ukabhaghabhila bhahochu mbija heyi, nanaghu wibya ulibheki chikoku kunani kumahunde. Panihapa nde uhika unyengalyaje.”
Nambu mundu jola paakajowini malobhi ghanighala, akayomiki namaa kwa ndandi akabhi na hindu yamaheli.
Yesu paakambweni ahakalili nakanopi akapwaghike, “Ntundu bhole mokunonupile kwaka mwanahindu yamaheli kujingi mu Ukolongwa waka Chapanga!
Kwa ndandi kupepwiki namaa kwa chinyama chekilowakeka ngamia kuholota mulimboghi la sindano kuliku mwanahindu yamaheli kujingi mu Ukolongwa waka Chapanga.”
Bhandu bhabhajowini malobhi ghanighala bhakalalukile, “Bho, henu nde nane joaweza kukengaleka?”
Yesu akayangike, “Mambu ghangakuwezikana kwa bhandu, ghawezikana kwaka Chapanga.”
Bhela Petulu akapwaghike, “Lingalya! Tepani tuilekiki hindu yitu yokapi na kukujengale wehapa!”
Yesu akamuyangiki, “Chakaka numpwaghila, ngati mundu anaajilekiki nyumba jaki, na nhwanu waki, na bhalongu bhaki, na bhabheleka bhaki, na bhana bhaki kwa ndandi ja Ukolongwa waka Chapanga,
anaajopalya ghamaheli nakanopi kwa chikahi cha sajenu, na mu ndema ghouhika ayijopalya womi wa mileli.”
Yesu alongela pakatatu panani ja kupotela na kuyoka kwaki

Yesu akabhatoliki bhabhulwa bhaki komi na bhabheli punkeghi na kubhapwaghila, “Njowanyaje! Tukwela kujenda ku Yelusalemu, na malembu ghokapi ghaghalembakiki na bhalota bhaka Chapanga panani jaka Mwana waka Mundu anaghapitalyaje.
Maghambu anabhunkamula na kumpeleka kwa bhandu bha Mataifa, anabhunhekaje, anabhuntondulaje na kunhuni imata.
Anabhundapulaje na kunkoma, nambu lichobha la katatu anaayokaje.”
Nambu bhabhulwa bhaki ngachebhamanyi ndandi ja malobhi ghanihagha, maghambu malobhi ghanihagha ghakahiyakiki kwabho, na bhombi ngachebhamanyi ngati Yesu alongalya panani ja kike.
Yesu andamiha ngalola
Yesu paakabhi aheghali muchi wa Yeliko, kukabhi na mundu jumu ngalola akatemi punkeghi ja indela akajopaje.
Paakajowini lipogha la bhandu bhakapetaje, akalalukile, “Bho, kubhi na kyane?”
Bhakumpwaghile, “Yesu wa ku Nazaleti apeta.”
Jombi akajamalili akapwagha, “Yesu! Mwana waka Daude! Umonila chiha!”
Bhandu bhabhalonguli bhala bhakundakalili na kumpwaghila atumbalaje. Nambu jombi akajendali kujamalila, akapwagha, “Mwana waka Daude! Umonila chiha!”
Yesu akajemiki na kubhalaghalaki bhundeta ngalola jola kwaki. Ngalola jola paakaheghalili pambipi, Yesu akundalukile,
“Bho, upala nukuhengila kyane?” Akayangiki, “Bambo, mbala kubhona kabhate.”
Yesu akumpwaghile, “Ubhonaje! Uhobhalelu waku ukulamihe.”
Palapala ngalola jola akaweziki kulola, na kunjengale Yesu koni akundumbalya Chapanga. Na bhandu bhokapi bhabhaliweni lijambu leniheli, na bhombi bhakundumbali Chapanga.
